2609.20620.title: A Simulation Platform for AUV Fault Recovery: Exploring LLM-Based Diagnostic Strategies
2609.20620.paper_summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating beyond reliable communications must recover from failures without human intervention. We investigate an architecture in which conventional deterministic layered control autonomy manages normal operations, while an invokable large language model (LLM) serves as a diagnostic and recovery planner when onboard anomaly detection identifies performance outside expected limits. Because language models are stochastic, rigorous evaluation requires ensemble testing rather than individual demonstrations. We present a closed-loop simulation architecture that couples real-time C vehicle software with a higher-level orchestration layer for physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, language-model interaction, mission file generation, validation, execution, and LLM-judge scoring. The framework, which we call SPAR (Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery), supports evaluation across fault realizations, prompt structures, reasoning models, and mission conditions. We vary these for a mass-shift fault over 480 SPAR trials, evaluating a frontier model and three off-the-shelf locally deployable LLMs. Model choice dominates diagnosis: the frontier model places the CG-shift mechanism in its top three hypotheses in 85-90% of trials, versus 60-78% for the best local model. Reasoning analysis indicates that local-model success is associated with following the complete diagnostic procedure, whereas weaker models often commit prematurely to elevator failure even though the actuator tracks its command. Diagnosis and operational decision performance do not appear to be coupled in this dataset. The contributions are an architecture extending unanticipated-fault recovery from detection to mitigation and an ensemble methodology for evaluating LLM-assisted mission management on low-power AUVs.
2609.20620.paper_summary_zh: 自主水下航行器（AUV）在可靠通信範圍之外操作時，必須在無需人類干預的情況下從故障中恢復。我們研究了一種架構，其中傳統的確定性分層控制自主性管理正常操作，而可調用的大型語言模型（LLM）則在機上異常檢測識別出性能超出預期範圍時，充當診斷和恢復規劃者。由於語言模型是隨機的，嚴格的評估需要進行集成測試，而不是單獨的演示。我們提出了一種閉環模擬架構，將實時C語言車輛軟體與更高級的編排層結合，用於基於物理的故障注入、結構化提示、語言模型互動、任務檔案生成、驗證、執行和LLM評分。這個框架，我們稱之為SPAR（AUV恢復模擬平台），支持在故障實現、提示結構、推理模型和任務條件之間進行評估。我們在480個SPAR試驗中針對一個質量轉移故障進行變化，評估了一個前沿模型和三個現成的本地可部署LLM。模型選擇主導診斷：前沿模型在85-90%的試驗中將CG轉移機制列為其前三個假設，而最佳本地模型則為60-78%。推理分析表明，本地模型的成功與遵循完整的診斷程序有關，而較弱的模型則經常過早地認定電梯故障，即使執行器仍在跟蹤其命令。在這個數據集中，診斷和操作決策性能似乎並不相關。這些貢獻是一種架構，將意外故障的恢復從檢測擴展到緩解，以及一種用於評估LLM輔助任務管理在低功耗AUV上的集成方法。
